name: Uprightness
overview: Scripture reveals that uprightness is a condition of the heart that pleases God and is essential for a faithful walk with Him. The upright are characterized by integrity, truthfulness, and a willingness to serve God wholeheartedly, as seen in 1 Chronicles 29:17 and 2 Chronicles 29:34. The Lord delights in righteousness and carefully observes those who live uprightly, promising prosperity and protection for the pure in heart (Job 8:6; Psalms 11:7). Yet, the upright often face scorn from others, highlighting the cost of godly integrity (Job 12:4; Psalms 15:2).
